name: Narrated explainer (Vox / Johnny Harris-style)
description: Narration-led explainer: question on screen first, a source or name lower-third, one key-fact callout and an end card. Slow push-ins and a low music bed (when you supply music) are added. Maps and archival B-roll are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

beats.name: Question or scene
beats.guidance: Open on a question or a concrete scene; make the topic clear within 10 seconds.

beats.name: Analysis
beats.guidance: Cut to the narration. Let the voice pause for emphasis; do not fill every second.
beats.footage: Archival clips, maps, simple text callouts.

beats.name: Counter-view
beats.guidance: Give the strongest opposing view fairly.

beats.name: Sources and next step
beats.guidance: Show where the facts come from.

effects.title: Slow push-ins
effects.description: A slow push-in on every shot of three seconds or more.

effects.title: Music under narration
effects.description: Music kept low so the voice stays clear, lowered further while someone speaks.

deferred.title: Archival and news B-roll
deferred.description: Clips cut to the narration, not as filler.

deferred.title: Maps and graphics
deferred.description: Maps, charts and simple text callouts.

notes.text: Footage, images, memes, logos and music from other people need permission or a licence that covers your use. Fair use depends on the country and is not automatic.

Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Name and date your sources. Do not present older footage as current, and keep quotes accurate and in context.
If any shot is AI-generated or altered to look real, check whether the platform requires a disclosure label.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.

confirmations.ask: Is every number and quote sourced and dated?
